prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: draw each object inside its grey box, as described. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the box in the top row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (144x144 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). the grand main gate of a royal castle seen straight from the front: a tall round-arched gateway of pale dressed stone with large carved voussoirs, heavy iron-studded wooden double doors standing open onto a dark passage, a raised iron portcullis just visible in the arch, and a blue shield with a golden crown carved above the arch; the stonework fills the box.
- the box in the top row of boxes, fourth position from the left edge of the page (48x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a tall narrow arched castle window with a pale carved stone frame and deep blue stained glass with thin gold leading, set in a wall, as tall as the box.
- the box in the middle row of boxes, fourth position from the left edge of the page (48x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a long royal banner hanging straight down a castle wall: deep blue cloth with a golden crown emblem, a gold fringe and a pointed bottom, hung from a short iron rod, as tall as the box.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, first position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a large carved stone garden urn on a short pedestal, planted with red and white flowers.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, second position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a neatly clipped round green topiary bush in a square pale stone planter.
- the box in the bottom row of boxes, third position from the left edge of the page (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a carved pale stone garden bench seen from the front.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
